presets.name: Draft
presets.description: Quick and cheap. Fine for test prints and stuff nobody looks at closely.

presets.name: Standard
presets.description: The sensible default. Good looks, decent strength.

presets.name: Strong
presets.description: Built like a brick. Takes longer and uses more filament, but survives the post.

toggles.name: Full colour
toggles.description: Each part in its own colour, as the design intends. Needs a multicolour unit with a spool for every colour.
toggles.off_description: The whole thing in a single colour. No swaps and no waste, but it sells for less and buyers like it less.

durability_labels.1: Fragile. Snaps easily, high chance of damage in the post.
durability_labels.2: Light duty. Fine for decor, risky for anything handled.
durability_labels.3: Normal. Survives everyday use and most deliveries.
durability_labels.5: Very tough. Almost never breaks in the post.
